description: This file contains source code for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) operations related to tensor indexing, including functions for indexing, index selection, masking, flipping, and scatter operations optimized for Apple GPUs using Metal API. It includes kernel dispatch setups, utility functions, and classes for representing cached MPS graphs specific to the Indexing operations.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Base class representing a cached Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) graph used for efficient re-use in tensor indexing operations.

classes.name: MPSUnaryCachedGraph
classes.description: Derived class specializing MPSCachedGraph for unary operations such as non-zero index extraction.

methods.name: generateKernelDataOffsets
methods.description: Generates the Metal compute kernel data offsets buffer for a given tensor iterator, considering 32-bit or 64-bit indexing.

methods.name: getBitSizeString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the bit size of a scalar type or tensor for Metal shader compilation.

methods.name: validateInputData
methods.description: Validates the input data for index kernels, ensuring correct dimensions and properties.

methods.name: masked_select_out_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements the masked_select operation optimized for MPS, selecting elements based on a boolean mask.

methods.name: dispatch_index_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches the Metal kernel for index operations with input validation.

methods.name: index_kernel_mps
methods.description: Performs index kernel operations using Metal shaders based on the provided index and tensor iterator.

methods.name: index_put_kernel_mps
methods.description: Dispatches kernel for index put operations, handling various scenarios including accumulation and serial execution.

methods.name: nonzero_fallback
methods.description: Fallback implementation of nonzero that runs on CPU when MPS support is unavailable.

methods.name: nonzero_out_native_mps
methods.description: Performs the nonzero operation using MPS, storing results in the provided tensor.

methods.name: nonzero_mps
methods.description: Public interface wrapping nonzero operation with fallback for unsupported data types or conditions.

methods.name: masked_select_mps
methods.description: Selects elements of a tensor according to a boolean mask, optimized for MPS.

methods.name: masked_select_out_mps
methods.description: Outputs the result of masked_select into a provided tensor.

methods.name: flip_mps
methods.description: Reverses tensor elements along specified dimensions, utilizing MPS for GPU acceleration.

methods.name: index_add_mps_out
methods.description: Performs an index add operation with Metal shaders, considering deterministic algorithms and data types.

methods.name: index_select_mps
methods.description: Selects slices of a tensor along a dimension using specified indices, implemented with MPS.

methods.name: index_select_out_mps
methods.description: Outputs the index selection result into a provided tensor, with validation and dispatch via MPS.

methods.name: index_fill_mps_
methods.description: Fills specified indices along a dimension with a scalar value in a tensor, using Metal.

methods.name: nonzero_mps
methods.description: Calculates the indices of non-zero elements in a tensor, optimized for MPS and with CPU fallback.

methods.name: masked_scatter__mps
methods.description: Replaces elements of a tensor at positions indicated by a mask with values from a source tensor, optimized for MPS.
